title: State of North Carolina Internship Program
sponsor: North Carolina Department of Administration, Division for Women and Youth
who_text: North Carolina residents attending a college, university, technical institute, or community college
description: You spend 10 weeks of summer working full time on a real project at a North Carolina state government agency. Interns work 40 hours a week and earn a stipend. Applications for summer 2026 closed on January 30.

title: Summer Ventures in Science and Mathematics
sponsor: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics
who_text: North Carolina students in their second or third year of high school who have not done Summer Ventures before
description: You live on a college campus for four weeks in the summer and do research on a STEM topic you choose. The program is free for accepted students, and meals on campus are included. There is no application fee.
